name: ProtoFluxOverhaul
description: Customizable node colors, rounded textures, and animated wires for your ProtoFlux nodes.

1.4.5.changelog: Two improvements, redesigned textures, added the option to color nodes by type

1.4.6.changelog: Fixed backwards clientside wire textures and added new toggles

1.4.8.changelog: Added Advanced Note Title, bug fixes, improved materials, changed text size

1.5.2.changelog:
- Fixed the RML assembly loading error.
- Fixed Node Create, Node Grab, Wire Grab and Connect sounds not playing properly. #29
- Fixed sounds only playing on the second interaction.
- Fixed sound caching after switching sessions or changing sound URLs. #34
- Added a wire dragging sound with changing pitch and playback speed (audible during slow movement, pauses when still, max 2x).
- Materials, textures and sprites are now shared from __TEMP/ProtoFluxOverhaul to reduce duplicated assets. #35
- Improved wire animation performance by animating shared materials while keeping input/output directions correct.
- Shared assets now stay in the world when their user leaves, keeping existing nodes and wires working.
- Texture and scrolling settings now update existing shared assets.
- Added custom material, texture and sound overrides from the user root or avatar. #13
- Added the Create Avatar Overrides toggle (creates editable overrides on your avatar and resets afterward).
- Avatar overrides are used directly, so edits to their materials and texture/sound URLs update live.
- Added automatic fallback to default assets when avatar overrides disappear.
- Node material overrides only apply to the main background (buttons, headers and shading keep their native materials).
- Generated Node materials now use the correct native depth and rendering settings.
- Fixed dropping an input over an input field pasting the node's header color. #36
- Fixed missing names on multiplication and other forced overview nodes.
- Fixed node names disappearing when styling is skipped or fails.
- Fixed PlatformColorPalette and other driven background colors being overwritten.
- Improved styling recovery, relay detection and overview handling while preserving compact node layouts.
- Improved error logging and added a separate Verbose Permission Logging toggle.
